name: Trend Vision One — IOC hunting
description: Search App queries for Trend Vision One. Field names depend on the selected data source: pick Endpoint Activity Data before running the endpoint templates and Network Activity Data for the network ones.

templates.name: Connections to the IP addresses
templates.description: Endpoint Activity Data. Matches the remote address of the connection.

templates.name: Connections in either direction
templates.description: Adds the source side, for inbound activity.

templates.name: Requests to the URLs or domains
templates.description: The request field carries the full URL observed by the agent.

templates.name: Files matching the hashes
templates.description: Object file hash on Endpoint Activity Data.

templates.name: Processes matching the hashes
templates.description: Hash of the process image rather than of a written file.

templates.name: Indicators inside a command line
templates.description: Catches downloaders that pass the address as an argument.

templates.name: Messages from the senders
templates.description: Requires the Email Activity Data source.
